verdict.rationale: The xAI API exposes a very broad surface. It covers text chat and structured outputs, tool calling (web search, code execution, remote MCP, collections), multi-agent research, file attachments, image generation and editing, video generation, editing and extension, TTS/STT and voice cloning. A Management API handles team administration, and an OpenAPI spec plus gRPC parity with REST support programmatic use. However, no source explicitly claims UI/API parity, and some settings appear to be console-driven (ZDR toggled in Team Settings, rate limits viewed in the Console). Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement or feature mapping, API control of console-only settings such as the ZDR toggle, and independent hands-on corroboration.
